clock_notes.shared_clock: Mapped image-pair capture timestamp differences from original column22 are applied to both unchanged motion estimates only for a clock-normalized diagnostic; no application output or trajectory is modified.
clock_notes.own_clocks: Original live uses irregular native/host capture intervals (~8/12ms); encoded AVI candidate has10ms PTS. Comparing rates on own clocks includes those time-base differences.

compute_costs.scope: Existing serial2-4s measured native cases after1s warmup; complete sourcevideo buffers, data and wire checked separately. One-coreCPU100%=one logicalcore; total-capacity percent divides by8. Cumulative tracker means are differenced across interval endpoints. Worker values are median/p95 of polled EMA samples, not a per-frame latency distribution; camera Input::next/acquisition+adapterdecode and pacing are subtracted, while whole-processCPU includes all workers/GUI/transports. In overload modes most steady CPU follows explicit optional-video stop, not successful ongoing encoding. No long-run or physical ground-truth claim.

scope: All5157 image decisions retained. Main comparisons use the fixed clear pre-hand[2,4680) annotation; other ranges split/complement the predeclared fast[1690,2100). Pairwise derivatives exclude mapped missing-source-image pairs and unaccepted/relocalized measurements; no rejected zero is treated as measured stillness. Reported zero-intercept scale/correlation diagnostics are not applied as fitted trajectory corrections. No new scientific pass threshold replaces existing oracle gates.
scale_note: All scale/correlation figures are descriptive diagnostics; no fitted correction is applied to trajectories or velocities.
